answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions. Each agent must compute non-parallelizable sequential steps anchored to an epoch beacon. An attacker incurs the scarce physical cost of dedicating distinct high-speed processor cores per identity. Whether transmitting sparrow acoustic data or monitoring a vineyard terrace, peers drop unverified telemetry. However, constant sequential calculation drains battery power and excludes low-spec edge devices.
